_comment: Loose daypart guardrails, in server-local time. `hours` is a [start, end) range in 24h clock; a window that wraps past midnight (like night) is written as start > end and handled that way in code. `mood` weights are matched against the same six-dimension mood vector AudioMuse-AI stores per track (happy/sad/aggressive/party/relaxed/danceable) - values are just relative targets, not required to sum to 1. `exploration` (low/medium/high, default medium) loosens how far from the target the adaptive picker is willing to wander -- higher means more variety, lower means it sticks closer to the mood target.
